extracted.name: Gremolata
extracted.description: Elevate your cooking with gremolata, a mixture of herbs, citrus zest, garlic and olive oil. It adds freshness and depth to meat, fish and roasted veg dishes
ingredient_lines: 2 unwaxed lemons zested and ½ lemon, juiced
instruction_lines: Finely chop the parsley, grate the garlic finely, then mix together with the lemon zest and juice in a small bowl. Stir in the oil. This will feel like quite a dry mixture compared to a pesto or a dressing, but more oil can be added if you prefer a looser consistency. To serve, sprinkle the gremolata over cooked meat or vegetables.
